rec.name: Feature Bubbles (Tabbed Product Component Benefits)
rec.status: Built — launched (tested internally by Christoph and Chris; developed by Rana)

what.text: A tabbed section that shows a row of round image 'bubbles' (e.g. Safety razor, Shaving brush set, Razor stand, Alum stone). Each bubble has a label underneath. Clicking one swaps the large hero image above and the benefit text below (a checkmark bullet list plus a short paragraph). The first tab is active by default and the active bubble gets a highlighted border and underlined label in an accent color. The bubbles overlap the bottom edge of the hero image. The block sits in a dark rounded box (boxed layout), with an optional full-width layout. It is a 1:1 recreation of the Störtebecker PDP section for a bundle/set product.

why.text: Bundle and set products are hard to scan, because shoppers cannot see what each component contributes. Clickable bubbles let shoppers explore each item's benefit on demand (progressive disclosure), which reduces clutter and raises perceived value of the whole set. Concrete benefit bullets with checkmarks answer 'why do I need this?' per item. Trust cues such as a test-winner badge on the hero image add credibility. Visual, tappable navigation also encourages engagement and scrolling depth on the PDP.

how.text: Create the section file ed-feature-bubbles.liquid and paste the provided code. Add one 'item' block per bubble, each with a bubble image, label, hero image, optional overlay avatar/badge (e.g. test-winner seal) and rich-text content (bullet list plus paragraph). Choose boxed or full-width layout, then set colors, sizes and spacing for desktop and mobile. A small vanilla JS script toggles the 'active' class on the clicked button, its content and its thumbnail, and activates the first tab on load. It also re-initializes on the shopify:section:load event in the theme editor. List bullets use a custom icon (list_icon) or a default star.svg fallback.

items: Section background and content background colors
Boxed: top/bottom and left/right padding, max width, corner radius, hero thumbnail height, avatar/badge size
Full-width: content position (left/center/right), max width, thumbnail height, avatar size
Bubble style (circle or rounded), size, position, gap, border toggle, border size
Label font size, weight, uppercase toggle, active underline toggle
Bubble text, active text, border and active border colors (global with per-block overrides)
Mobile: thumbnail height, avatar width, bubble size, font size, gaps, alignment, content alignment, option to hide labels
Per block: bubble image, label, hero image, overlay avatar/badge, rich-text content

dependencies.text: No app or metafields required; all content is configured in the theme editor blocks. Assumes an OS 2.0 theme with section blocks, and that the theme provides a .container class and a .heading font class. Default list icon expects /cdn/shop/files/star.svg to exist. Placed on the PDP, mainly for set/bundle products.

items: Scroll depth and engagement on the PDP

images.caption: Final UI: dark rounded box with hero image (with test-winner badge overlay), four circular bubbles (Safety razor active with highlighted underlined label), and checkmark benefit bullets plus paragraph below.
Bubbles overlap the hero image's bottom edge; active bubble is shown in an accent color with underline; content text is left-aligned.
